description: Final polish: strip confidence/severity/classification from renderCaptureAnalysis (show only image + CRACK CONFIRMED + timestamp), fix alert banner to stay visible during cooldown (only hide on monitoring), make banner more imposing (2rem, solid red, glow, text-shadow), remove confidence/dimension text from dashboard.html, replace broken winsdk letsview capture with pywin32 PrintWindow fallback.
steps: 1. In static/js/dashboard.js renderCaptureAnalysis(): removed confidence %, classification badge, severity bar. Now shows only capture image, 'CRACK CONFIRMED' heading, and timestamp.

2. In static/js/dashboard.js pollAnalysis(): changed hideAlertBanner() and AudioManager.resetForNewCapture() to only trigger on state === 'monitoring', not 'cooldown'. Banner stays visible during cooldown.
3. In static/style.css: upgraded .crack-alert-banner to font-size 2rem, padding 24px 32px, solid #c0392b background, red glow box-shadow, text-shadow for visibility, blink opacity to 0.2.

4. In templates/dashboard.html: replaced step 3 description and feature card description to remove references to confidence percentage, estimated dimensions, confidence scoring, dimensional measurements.

5. In letsview_source.py: replaced broken winsdk GraphicsCaptureItem.create_from_window_handle approach with pywin32 PrintWindow (PW_RENDERFULLCONTENT=2) that correctly captures windows even when covered. Updated requirements.txt comment from winsdk to pywin32.
6. Added .crack-confirmed-heading CSS style for the new CRACK CONFIRMED heading element.
acceptance_criteria: renderCaptureAnalysis shows only image + CRACK CONFIRMED + timestamp (no confidence/classification/severity)
Alert banner stays visible during cooldown, only hides on monitoring
Banner CSS: font-size 2rem, solid #c0392b, glow box-shadow, text-shadow, blink to 0.2 opacity
dashboard.html has no references to confidence percentage, estimated dimensions, confidence scoring, or dimensional measurements
letsview_source.py uses pywin32 PrintWindow with PW_RENDERFULLCONTENT=2 (graceful False on non-Windows)
